summary: The Docker build failed while executing a wget command to download the Nydus release archive. The subsequent context-canceled errors and cache reservation message are downstream cleanup effects or non-fatal post-job events.
root_cause: The wget download of the Nydus archive failed with exit code 1, causing the BuildKit solve to fail; the context shows related layer fetches being canceled.

evidence.quote: process "/bin/bash -c wget https://github.com/dragonflyoss/nydus/releases/download/$NYDUS_VERSION/nydus-static-$NYDUS_VERSION-$TARGETOS-$TARGETARCH.tgz" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
evidence.reason: This explicitly identifies the failing build command and its nonzero exit status.

evidence.quote: error="failed to do request: Get \"https://cdn01.quay.io/quayio-production-s3/sha256/02/0288b5a0d7e71a2cdbdf114cb9869ce2bc4b05adfd6aa5e3ee9fa4b3847e7b80?...\": context canceled"
evidence.reason: The registry layer request was canceled during the failed build, indicating an interrupted network-dependent operation.

evidence.quote: error="failed to do request: Get \"https://quay.io/v2/minio/minio/blobs/sha256:c1bc68842c41cb716734641f75dc37d629f05df5f812a8cc2e7e0370d4e833ec\": context canceled"
evidence.reason: A second external layer fetch was also canceled as the solve terminated.

suggested_fix: Retry the CI job and investigate the network access or availability of the GitHub Nydus release download used by the wget command.
